title: KoreLumina — Master OS - KoreLumina Runtime Recovery

messages.content:
This result is actually useful.
The important part is:
JSON"totals": {
  "eventClients": 0,
  "workspaceWatchers": 0,
  "runtimes": 0,
  "running": 0
}
That confirms:


Runtime service is healthy.


Metrics endpoint is wired.


Registry is empty.


No project runtime is currently registered.


No filesystem watchers are attached.


No builder client is connected to runtime events.


This means the next architecture ticket is not "fixing" anything.
The next ticket is validating the Runtime Observability layer already defined in the architecture:


Runtime Registry


Runtime Metrics


Runtime Logs


Runtime Events


Runtime Health


Runtime Lifecycle Dashboard


You already have:
✅ /api/runtime/metrics
✅ /api/runtime/logs
✅ /api/runtime/events
✅ Runtime registry
✅ PID monitoring
✅ Memory monitoring
✅ Uptime monitoring
What is missing is the Builder UI consuming them.
Before writing code, verify what already exists:
Bashgrep -R "runtime/metrics" apps/lumina-builder/src

echo "===================="

grep -R "getRuntimeMetrics" apps/lumina-builder/src

echo "===================="

If those searches return nothing, then the architecture gap is clear:
Runtime backend exists, Runtime observability UI does not.
That would make the next development ticket:
Runtime Operations Dashboard
Display:


Runtime count


Running/Starting/Error counts


Runtime memory usage


Runtime uptime


Active SSE clients


Active filesystem watchers


Per-project runtime status


Restart button


Stop button

First determine whether any of that UI already exists before building new components. The grep results above will tell us.

That output tells us exactly where we are.
The architecture defines the capability:
TypeScriptdeploymentDiagnostics: boolean;
and the role system exposes it:
TypeScriptdeploymentDiagnostics: true
but there is currently no implementation in the builder UI.
Your grep confirms:


No Diagnostics workspace


No Runtime Health dashboard


No Metrics panel


No Runtime Monitor component


No consumer of /api/runtime/metrics

}

What is missing is the Builder layer.
